response.sql:
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS raceName, AVG(cr.points) AS avgPoints, COUNT(*) AS resultCount
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
name_avg AS (
  SELECT raceName, AVG(avgPoints) AS nameAvg
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT ra.raceId, ra.raceName, ra.avgPoints, ra.resultCount, ra.avgPoints / na.nameAvg AS ratio
FROM race_avg ra
JOIN name_avg na ON na.raceName = ra.raceName
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The higher side of the 1.0 dividing line means strictly greater than 1.0 (constructorResults.points > 1.0), so results worth exactly 1.0 are dropped.

The race-name average is taken only over races that have at least one kept result, since races with no kept results have no per-race average to contribute. Races with a NULL name are excluded by the join.
